ns2:course.label: Sr Seminar in Musicology
ns2:course.description: Intensive capstone seminar for musicology majors directed at graduate school preparation, senior thesis or project development, professional portfolio design, and the cultivation of scholarly writing skills. Introduces advanced research methods and analytical paradigms. Addresses special topics or issues tailored to student interests and faculty expertise, as well as contemporary developments in the discipline or current musical events, from diverse perspectives. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: For senior musicology majors (BA or BM) with senior standing, or consent of instructor.
